proposedBy: Codex, implementing the LLP 0063 Step 4 remediation
ratifier: Charlie Cheever, as named by partitime.comparison-protocol.v1

invalidates.disposition: Preserve the 348-line threshold and every receipt that evaluated it as historical v1 evidence. They may not validate the replacement source-volume claim.

supportInventory.rule: Report entry, provider, hydration, prerender, and other integration-support files separately with both bytes and physical lines. Do not silently charge a capability implemented by only one arm to the shared product-authoring row.

cause.finding: The v1 React inventory omitted styles.css (11,552 authored bytes) while Contract's inline styles and UI helpers were counted. The frozen 348-line threshold also predates the production hydration and prerender obligations later added to the Contract-only Step 7 workload, but the comparison protocol never rolled the source workload. Physical lines further reward the React stylesheet's packed multi-declaration formatting.
cause.notAProductOptimization: The replacement does not remove Contract files or reformat either arm to win a line counter. It completes the React product inventory, uses byte volume to avoid physical-line packing, and separates asymmetric platform-support obligations from the shared product workload.
